SPARSE.definition: a real contact with 30-100 lifetime messages

PHRASE_HI.definition: >= 200 lifetime FTS hits, usage visibly changed across years

TERM.definition: top-lift dyad_terms row for TOP1's chat

NOBODY.definition: plausible full name matching no contact

YEAR.definition: most recent full calendar year in the corpus

LONG_MSG.definition: a message I sent TOP1 longer than TEXT_PREVIEW_CHARS, so a search hit truncates it and only get_full_messages recovers the rest

REACTED_MSG.definition: the message I sent TOP1 carrying the most reactions
